The Contractor shall provide manufacturer-required preventive maintenance and corrective repair services for one EchoSens FibroScan MINI 430+ medical device. Services are limited strictly to medical equipment maintenance and do not include information technology services.

The Contractor shall provide all labor, OEM parts, tools, test equipment, calibration resources, travel, and technical expertise necessary to maintain the device in accordance with EchoSens manufacturer specifications.

*DO NOT SUBMIT A QUOTE OR ANY PRICING INFORMATION TO THIS NOTICE*
